dataset: NCHS - VSRR Quarterly provisional estimates for selected indicators of mortality
source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics (Vital Statistics Rapid Release)
measure: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 (2000 U.S. standard population); U.S. age-group rates are age-specific (crude) rates
leading: Pneumonitis due to solids and liquids

deaths2022.dataset: Provisional COVID-19 Deaths by Sex and Age
deaths2022.note: New York includes New York City (reported separately by NCHS and added here).

counts2022.dataset: Weekly Provisional Counts of Deaths by State and Select Causes, 2020-2023
counts2022.note: Deaths in 2022 by state where the death occurred (not state of residence), summed from MMWR weeks of 2022. Natural causes only. A total is not shown when CDC suppressed any week (1 to 9 deaths). New York includes New York City.
